summary: Marion County, TX tower: Texas Forest Service crew base in 1957; moved downtown in 2003 and now a privately owned Etex Wireless cell tower.

facts.status_note: No longer at the original site; the tower stands downtown in Jefferson as a cell tower

staffing.status: Texas Forest Service crew leader posted

access.note: Owned by Etex Wireless and used as a cell tower. The register says local groups are offering to help open it, but we found no report that this has happened.

facts.agency: Etex Wireless (current owner and administrator per the register); the Texas Forest Service staffed the tower in 1957

events.note: A new Texas Forest Service crew leader joined at the Jefferson lookout tower, per a Marshall News Messenger item dated September 30, 1957, quoted by the Central US page
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description written, placing the tower about 1.5 miles west-northwest of Jefferson, with an overall height of about 100 feet
Moved by the Jeffersonian Institute to its present location in downtown Jefferson
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: Build date not found in the three sources read, so there is no built event. Record: the register describes the tower as it now stands downtown, so its design details apply to the moved structure; the 1958 NGS description (reproduced on the Central US page) describes the original site 1.5 miles west-northwest of Jefferson. NGS gives 'overall height of about 100 feet', used for height_m 30.5; it is not a cab-floor height. The 1957 newspaper item is quoted on the Central US page, not read from the newspaper. The register's 2003 move date is the only source for the relocation; the lookout list supports the move but not the year. Access is private: owned by Etex Wireless and used as a cell tower. Two web searches and about five page reads were used, and the Jeffersonian Institute and Jefferson tourism pages gave no tower detail. Worth checking: the Texas Forest Service history of the Jefferson tower, and whether Etex has agreed to the restoration offered.
